import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_24/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_24/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_24/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_24/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_24/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_24/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_24/training_6.csv"
]

# Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    # Ensure columns are exactly as target schema and types
    df = df[['Name', 'Team', 'Position', 'SnapsPlayed']]
    # Enforce types explicitly
    df['Name'] = df['Name'].astype(str)
    df['Team'] = df['Team'].astype(str)
    df['Position'] = df['Position'].astype(str)
    df['SnapsPlayed'] = df['SnapsPlayed'].astype(int)
    dfs.append(df)

# Operation: UNION all source tables in the given order
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Write the result to the target path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_24/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
